proposition: Ibn Turka was in correspondence with practitioners of the 'legitimate' sciences: Qāżīzāda Rūmī, director of Ulugh Beg's observatory in Samarkand, wrote to him, and letter 31 greets the astronomer Badr al-Dīn at the Kārkiyā court in Gilan.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Kārkiyā court / from Qāżīzāda Rūmī
mediation.where: Munshaʾāt-i Turka letter 31; MS Majlis 10196 f. 153b
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
